zin_stabilo_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = {
				has_country_flag = zin_stabilo_debts_set
			}
		}
		set_country_flag = zin_stabilo_debts_set
		Y15 = {
			set_variable = { zin_stabilo_debt = 20 }
		}
		Y5V = {
			set_variable = { zin_stabilo_debt = 10 }
		}
		Y5L = {
			set_variable = { zin_stabilo_debt = 10 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_stabilo_ledger_income } } }
		add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = zin_stabilo_ledger_income }
	}
	set_variable = { zin_stabilo_ledger_total = 0 }
	every_country = {
		limit = { zin_east_is_court = yes }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { zin_stabilo_debt > 0 }
				check_variable = { zin_stabilo_debt < 100 }
			}
			add_to_variable = { zin_stabilo_debt = 0.2 }
			clamp_variable = { var = zin_stabilo_debt min = 0 max = 100 }
		}
		ROOT = { add_to_variable = { zin_stabilo_ledger_total = PREV.zin_stabilo_debt } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { zin_stabilo_debt > 89 }
				NOT = { has_country_flag = zin_stabilo_cannot_pay }
			}
			set_country_flag = { flag = zin_stabilo_cannot_pay days = 730 }
			ROOT = { country_event = { id = zin_stabilo.32 } }
		}
	}
	set_variable = { zin_stabilo_ledger_pp = zin_stabilo_ledger_total }
	divide_variable = { zin_stabilo_ledger_pp = 2000 }
	clamp_variable = { var = zin_stabilo_ledger_pp min = 0 max = 0.25 }
	set_variable = { zin_stabilo_ledger_trade = zin_stabilo_ledger_total }
	divide_variable = { zin_stabilo_ledger_trade = 2500 }
	clamp_variable = { var = zin_stabilo_ledger_trade min = 0 max = 0.2 }
	force_update_dynamic_modifier = yes
	set_variable = { zin_stabilo_rivalry = global.zin_east_rivalry }
	set_variable = { zin_stabilo_road_salt = global.zin_east_road_salt }
	set_variable = { zin_stabilo_road_gold = global.zin_east_road_gold }
	set_variable = { zin_stabilo_road_rift = global.zin_east_road_rift }
	set_variable = { zin_stabilo_road_lake = global.zin_east_road_lake }
	set_variable = { zin_stabilo_road_sand = global.zin_east_road_sand }
}

# Arguments: zin_arg_who (country), zin_arg_modifier (1-based position in the opinion_modifiers block), zin_arg_both (1 for both ways).
zin_stabilo_opinion = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_arg_modifier = 1 }
		}
		add_opinion_modifier = {
			target = var:zin_arg_who
			modifier = zin_stabilo_pact_renewed
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { zin_arg_both = 1 }
			}
			reverse_add_opinion_modifier = {
				target = var:zin_arg_who
				modifier = zin_stabilo_pact_renewed
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_arg_modifier = 2 }
		}
		add_opinion_modifier = {
			target = var:zin_arg_who
			modifier = zin_stabilo_pact_goodwill
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { zin_arg_both = 1 }
			}
			reverse_add_opinion_modifier = {
				target = var:zin_arg_who
				modifier = zin_stabilo_pact_goodwill
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			check_variable = { zin_arg_modifier = 3 }
		}
		add_opinion_modifier = {
			target = var:zin_arg_who
			modifier = zin_stabilo_defaulted
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				check_variable = { zin_arg_both = 1 }
			}
			reverse_add_opinion_modifier = {
				target = var:zin_arg_who
				modifier = zin_stabilo_defaulted
			}
		}
	}
}
